svg.title: Walking path clearances
svg.desc: A continuous 1.5 metre clear pedestrian corridor with 2.2 metre overhead clearance and a separate 3 metre under-building recommendation. Source claims: clear-route-continuity. Assistant illustration draft. Route segment 6 m, pavement width 2.5 m, passing-place length 1.2 m, furniture, suspended overhead fragments and ground relief are assumed. Their layout illustrates the retained source dimensions, not a complete compliant design.
